about.intro: I build responsive, secure and scalable web applications across frontend, backend and database layers.
about.description: Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building scalable web applications using React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Python/Django, Flask and RESTful APIs. Focused on clear backend architecture, input validation, database design, and clean maintainable code.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Muhammad Sahal**, a Full Stack Developer based in Bangalore, India.

I specialize in building scalable, secure, and responsive web applications across the entire stack. My experience spans frontend user interfaces with React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap, as well as robust backend services using Python/Django, Flask, and RESTful APIs with MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB databases.

I have designed role-based applications, implemented secure authentication and authorization systems (session-based and bcrypt hashing), engineered CSRF protections, and built AI-enabled services using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and prompt engineering.

I am pursuing a B.E. in Information Science and Engineering at Yenepoya Institute of Technology (affiliated to VTU), graduating in 2026.

projects.title: SalamMart
projects.description: Full-stack grocery e-commerce platform with Customer, Staff and Owner/Admin modules.
highlights: Role-based authentication and authorization with CSRF protection and form validation.
Product search, filtering, wishlist, cart, pincode delivery verification, and checkout.
Complete order lifecycle management with automatic stock restoration after order cancellation.
Owner/Admin and Staff dashboards for catalog, order, user role, and inventory management.
Responsive customer interface built with Django MVT and a reusable CSS component system.

caseStudy.problem: Online grocery purchasing and management requires distinct user role permissions, secure transaction workflows, and reliable stock lifecycle management.
caseStudy.solution: A role-based full-stack grocery application built using Django, featuring Customer, Staff, and Owner/Admin control panels.

architectureDiagram.frontend: HTML5 / CSS3 / JavaScript (Reusable CSS Component System)
roles: Customer Module: Catalog Browsing, Search, Wishlist, Cart, Pincode Delivery Check, Checkout, Order Tracking
Staff Dashboard: Catalog Maintenance & Order Fulfillment Operations
Owner/Admin Dashboard: User Management, Inventory Control & Automatic Stock Restoration

projects.title: AI Career Companion
projects.description: AI-powered career companion focused on improving the job-search and career preparation workflow.

projects.title: Salon Appointment Booking Platform

projects.title: Food Waste Management E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: E-commerce platform designed to allow restaurants to sell surplus food online.

otherProjects.title: Smart Document Analyzer
otherProjects.description: A local application that extracts text from PDFs, retrieves relevant passages, and answers questions using RAG and semantic search.

Added document validation, semantic search, and local model inference.

otherProjects.title: Password Authentication System
otherProjects.description: A Flask and bcrypt-powered authentication system with registration, secure password hashing, login, sessions, and a personalized dashboard.
